scoring_justification: The agent submits only the final consolidated numbers (mas_results.json); no raw total energies or wavefunctions are required. T0 comparison against the paper-reported gold is the natural and appropriate scoring method. Tolerance accounts for expected DFT code differences.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold values for magnetic moment, MAE, and easy axis for each of the four TM@B systems.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Extracted from Table I of the paper (DOI:10.1063/1.4798478). Fe@B: moment=1 μB, MAE=1.19 meV; Mn@B: moment=2 μB, MAE=-0.63 meV; Sc@B: moment=0 μB (nonmagnetic); Co@B: moment=0 μB (nonmagnetic). Easy axes follow the sign rule: positive MAE → in-plane, negative → out-of-plane, zero moment → none.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Directly transcribed from the published table.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own reported numbers, traceable to Table I. They are consistent with the reference solve.sh output.

outputs.description: Consolidated results of magnetic moment, MAE, and easy axis for Fe@B, Mn@B, Sc@B, Co@B.

output_contract.notes: The hidden checker compares the reported values against paper-reported references with appropriate tolerances. For nonmagnetic systems (Sc@B, Co@B) the expectation is magnetic_moment_muB=0, MAE_meV=null, easy_axis='none'.
